Exercise 1: Exploratory Data Analysis

college_grad_median <- college_grad_df |> 
  select(major_category, median) |> 
  group_by(major_category) |> 
  summarise(mean_earnings = mean(median))

ggplot(college_grad_median,
       aes(x = mean_earnings,
           fill = major_category)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2500) +
  labs(x = "mean")

Your explanation

Exercise 2: Exploring relationship

ggplot(college_grad_df,
       aes(x = median,
           y = sharewomen,
           colour = major_category)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = lm, se = FALSE,
              colour = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Percentage of women against median earnings",
       x = "Median Earnings",
       y = "Percentage of Women")
## `geom_smooth()` using formula = 'y ~ x'
## Warning: Removed 1 row containing non-finite outside the scale range
